content.text:
The minimum part payment is now 10% of what the invoice still owes when the payment arrives, not 10% of its grand total. `bin/e2e` passes.

The change is on the server only:
- **`Invoice.java`**: `minimumPart` now takes the amount already paid and returns 10% of the amount still due, rounded half-up. The check that rejects a too-small payment uses it.
- **`InvoiceService.java`**: both the single-invoice payment path and the split-payment path now pass in what has been paid so far. Their error messages now say "10% of what it still has due" instead of "10% of the total".

Two parts of the old behaviour stay as they were:
- A payment that settles the invoice is still always accepted.
- The amount checked is what reaches the invoice after any card surcharge or conversion fee. In the test, $36.85 by card only gets $35.95 to the invoice, below the $36.00 minimum, so it's rejected; $36.90 gets exactly $36.00 there and is accepted.

Invoices on a payment plan still use their own rule (the unpaid part of the earliest instalment), and the front end didn't need changing because it doesn't check the minimum itself.
